title: 9-Day Turkey & Egypt Highlights: Istanbul to Cairo
metaDescription: Discover Istanbul and Cappadocia before flying to Cairo on a focused 9-day journey combining Turkey's cultural landmarks with Egypt's ancient wonders.

9-Day Turkey & Egypt Highlights: Istanbul to Cairo
summary:
The 9-Day Turkey & Egypt Highlights Tour connects Istanbul and Cappadocia with Cairo and Alexandria, covering two distinct sides of Egypt within a compact route. Explore Istanbul before flying to Cappadocia, then continue to Cairo for the Pyramids of Giza and scheduled sightseeing. Alexandria adds Egypt’s Mediterranean dimension, creating a broader experience without extending the journey to the Nile Valley or southern Egypt.
The escorted program includes selected 4-star hotels, breakfast, guided sightseeing, entrance fees, airport transfers, three domestic flights and the international Istanbul–Cairo flight.

itinerary.title: Arrival Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Arrival in Istanbul (Istanbul Airport). Meet and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Oldcity Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise- Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text:
After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45.
Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgupr and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappado

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia tour- Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soganli Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements Transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Istanbul (19:30–21:00). Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul to Cairo by Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast. Check out and transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight to Cairo (14:00–15:20).
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Tour to Pyramids and Sphinx
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the colossal statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to visit the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser. Later, explore the Pyramids of Giza built for Cheops, Chephren, and Mycerinus, along with the mysterious Great Sphinx of Giza.. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Egyptian Museum, Old Cairo Tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the Grand Egyptian Museum before continuing to the historic Cairo Citadel and the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Explore Old Cairo and visit the Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church and the Hanging Church. Later, enjoy free time at the famous Khan el-Khalili bazaar. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Cairo Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Cairo
Check-out and transfer to Cairo International Airport according to your flight schedule

faqs.q: What does the 9-Day Turkey and Egypt Highlights tour include?
faqs.a: This 9-day tour offers a streamlined taste of two countries. You explore Istanbul with Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, and Topkapi Palace, discover the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia, then fly to Cairo to see the Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, and the Egyptian Museum. The trip runs for 8 nights and 9 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 9-Day Turkey and Egypt Highlights tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from 2,295 euros per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided tours, entrance fees, lunches on tour days, internal flights, and transfers in both Turkey and Egypt.

faqs.q: Who is the 9-day Highlights tour best suited for?
faqs.a: This tour is ideal for travelers with limited time who still want to experience the best of both Turkey and Egypt. It focuses on the essential highlights of Istanbul, Cappadocia, and Cairo, making it a compact yet rewarding introduction to the region in just nine days.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the 9-day Highlights tour?
faqs.a: Yes, internal flights are included, connecting Istanbul with Cappadocia and Turkey with Cairo. These flights keep travel times short between distant destinations. International flights into Istanbul and out of Cairo are not included.

faqs.q: Does this tour include a Nile cruise?
faqs.a: No, this 9-day Highlights tour does not include a Nile cruise and focuses on Cairo for the Egypt portion. If you would like to add a Nile cruise from Aswan to Luxor, consider the longer 11-day Turkey and Egypt tour or ask us to customize your itinerary.

faqs.q: What are the main highlights of this 9-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Highlights include Istanbul's Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, and Topkapi Palace, the unique landscapes and cave dwellings of Cappadocia, and Cairo's Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, and the Egyptian Museum. It captures the most iconic sights of both countries in a short trip.

faqs.q: What accommodation is provided on the Highlights tour?
faqs.a: The package includes 8 nights at 4-star hotels on a bed and breakfast basis, along with all transfers in Turkey and Egypt. Hotels are chosen for comfort and good access to the main attractions.

faqs.q: How physically demanding is the 9-day tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. There is regular walking at historic sites and museums, sometimes in warm weather, plus a few internal flights and early starts. Travelers in reasonable health generally find the pace comfortable.

faqs.q: Are meals included on the 9-day Turkey and Egypt Highlights tour
faqs.a: Lunches are included on guided tour days and breakfast is served daily at the hotels. Dinners, drinks during meals, and any meals not mentioned in the itinerary are not included, so evenings are free to enjoy local cuisine.

faqs.q: Can the 9-Day Turkey and Egypt Highlights tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized. You can add destinations such as Ephesus or Pamukkale, include a Nile cruise, upgrade hotels, or extend your stay. Contact Magnificent Travel with your dates and group size for a tailored quote.
